dialogue: Kitne aadmi the?
english_translation: How many men were there?

dialogue: Yeh haath humko de de Thakur!
english_translation: Give these hands to me, Thakur!

dialogue: Jo darr gaya, samjho marr gaya.
english_translation: He who gets scared, consider him dead.

dialogue: Basanti, in kutton ke samne mat nachna!
english_translation: Basanti, do not dance in front of these dogs!

dialogue: Tumhara naam kya hai, Basanti?
english_translation: What is your name, Basanti?

dialogue: Yahan se pachaas pachaas kos door gaon mein, jab bachha raat ko rota hai, toh maa kehti hai beta soja, nahi toh Gabbar aa jayega.
english_translation: In villages fifty miles from here, when a child cries at night, the mother says sleep child, or Gabbar will arrive.

dialogue: Hum angrezon ke zamane ke jailor hain, ha ha!
english_translation: I am a jailor from the British era, ha ha!

dialogue: Arre o Sambha, kitna inaam rakhe hain sarkar hum par?
english_translation: Hey Sambha, how much bounty has the government placed on me?

dialogue: Mere paas maa hai!
english_translation: I have mother with me!

dialogue: Aaj mere paas building hai, property hai, bank balance hai, bangla hai, gaadi hai... tumhare paas kya hai?
english_translation: Today I have buildings, property, bank balance, a mansion, cars... what do you have?

dialogue: Main aaj bhi phenke hue paise nahi uthata.
english_translation: Even today, I don't pick up money that is thrown at me.

dialogue: Uff tumhare usool, tumhare aadarsh! Kis kaam ke hain yeh usool?
english_translation: Oh your principles, your ideals! What good are these principles?

dialogue: Jao pehle us aadmi ka sign le kar aao jisne mere baap ko chor kaha tha.
english_translation: Go first and bring the signature of that man who called my father a thief.

dialogue: Babumoshai, zindagi badi honi chahiye, lambi nahi.
english_translation: Babumoshai, life should be grand, not long.

dialogue: Maut toh ek pal hai... babumoshai, maut aur zindagi toh upar wale ke haath mein hai.
english_translation: Death is just a moment... life and death are in the hands of the Almighty above.

dialogue: Hum sab rangmanch ki kathputliyan hain jinki dor upar wale ke haath mein hai.
english_translation: We are all puppets on a stage whose strings are pulled by the One above.

dialogue: Anand mara nahi, Anand marte nahi.
english_translation: Anand didn't die, people like Anand never die.

dialogue: All is well!
english_translation: All is well!

dialogue: Kamyab hone ke liye nahi, kabil hone ke liye padho. Success ke peeche mat bhago, excellence ka peecha karo, success jhak maarke peeche aayegi.
english_translation: Study not to be successful, but to be capable. Pursue excellence, and success will inevitably chase you.

dialogue: Dost fail ho jaye toh dukh hota hai, lekin dost first aa jaye toh zyada dukh hota hai.
english_translation: If a friend fails, you feel bad. But if a friend comes first, you feel even worse.

dialogue: Life is a race... if you don't run fast, you will be like a broken egg.
english_translation: Life is a race... if you don't run fast, you will be crushed like a broken egg.

dialogue: Arey kehna kya chahte ho?
english_translation: What exactly are you trying to say?

dialogue: Jahanpanah tussi great ho, tohfa kabool karo!
english_translation: Your majesty, you are great, please accept our tribute!

dialogue: Bade bade deshon mein aisi chhoti chhoti baatein hoti rehti hain, Senorita.
english_translation: In big countries, such small things keep happening, Senorita.

dialogue: Jaa Simran jaa, jee le apni zindagi.
english_translation: Go Simran, go live your life.

dialogue: Agar yeh tujhe pyaar karti hai toh yeh palat ke dekhegi... Palat... Palat... Palat!
english_translation: If she loves you, she will turn back and look... Turn... Turn... Turn!

dialogue: Koi bhi sapna poora hone se pehle sach nahi lagta.
english_translation: No dream feels real until it comes true.

dialogue: Baap ka, dada ka, bhai ka... sabka badla lega re tera Faizal!
english_translation: Father's, grandfather's, brother's... your Faizal will avenge everyone!

dialogue: Beta, tumse na ho payega.
english_translation: Son, you won't be able to pull this off.

dialogue: Hindustan mein jab tak cinema hai, log ch***ya bante rahenge.
english_translation: As long as there is cinema in India, people will continue to be fooled.

dialogue: Hazrat hazrat hazrat... Khan saab ka pehla qatl!
english_translation: Ladies and gentlemen... Khan saab's first murder!

dialogue: Yahan har koi hero banna chahta hai apni picture ka.
english_translation: Everyone here wants to be the hero of their own movie.

dialogue: Teri keh ke lunga!
english_translation: I will openly take my revenge and announce it beforehand!

dialogue: Aap purush hi nahi, mahapurush hain!
english_translation: You are not just a man, you are a great soul!

dialogue: Crime Master Gogo naam hai mera, aankhen nikaal kar gotiyan khelta hoon!
english_translation: Crime Master Gogo is my name, I pluck out eyeballs and play marbles with them!

dialogue: Teja main hoon, mark idhar hai.
english_translation: I am Teja, the mark is right here.

dialogue: Aaya hoon, kuch toh loot kar jaunga... khandani chor hoon main!
english_translation: I have come, I won't leave empty-handed... I am an ancestral thief!

dialogue: Galti se mistake ho gaya.
english_translation: A mistake happened by error.

dialogue: Do dost ek pyaali mein chai piyenge, isse dosti badhti hai.
english_translation: Two friends drinking tea from the same cup, that deepens friendship.

dialogue: Don ko pakadna mushkil hi nahi, namumkin hai.
english_translation: Catching Don is not just difficult, it is impossible.

dialogue: Don ke dushman ki sabse badi galti yeh hai ki woh Don ka dushman hai.
english_translation: The biggest mistake of Don's enemy is that he is Don's enemy.

dialogue: Don apne doston ka haal jaane ya na jaane, apne dushmano ki khabar zaroor rakhta hai.
english_translation: Whether Don knows how his friends are doing or not, he always keeps track of his enemies.

dialogue: Mujhe jungli billiyan bahut pasand hain.
english_translation: I really like wild cats.

dialogue: Yeh Baburao ka style hai!
english_translation: This is Baburao's style!

dialogue: Khopdi tod, khopdi tod saale ka!
english_translation: Break his skull, smash this fellow's skull!

dialogue: Utha le re baba, utha le... mereko nahi re, in dono ko utha le!
english_translation: Take them away Lord, take them away... not me, take these two away!

dialogue: Kutreya... main Baburao bol raha hoon!
english_translation: You dog... this is Baburao speaking!

dialogue: Golmaal hai bhai sab golmaal hai.
english_translation: Everything is fishy here, brother.

dialogue: 21 din mein paisa double!
english_translation: Double your money in 21 days!

dialogue: Zor zor se bolke logon ko scheme bata de!
english_translation: Shout loudly and leak the scheme to everyone!

dialogue: Dene ka re baba, isko dene ka.
english_translation: Give it to him brother, give it to him.

dialogue: Jaadu ki jhappi!
english_translation: A magical hug!

dialogue: Carrom ramwanu, juice peewanu, majja ni life!
english_translation: Play carrom, drink juice, enjoy life to the fullest!

dialogue: Bole toh ekdum rapchik!
english_translation: In other words, completely stunning!

dialogue: Tension lene ka nahi, sirf dene ka!
english_translation: Never take stress, only give stress!

dialogue: Desh toh apna aazad ho gaya par hum aaj bhi aazad nahi hain.
english_translation: Our country gained freedom, yet we are still not truly free.

dialogue: Salim tujhe marne nahi dega, aur hum Anarkali tujhe jeene nahi denge.
english_translation: Salim will not let you die, and I, Anarkali, will not let you live.

dialogue: Taqdeerein badal jaati hain, zamana badal jaata hai, mulkon ki tarikh badal jaati hai... magar mohabbat jis insaan ka daaman thaam leti hai, woh insaan nahi badalta.
english_translation: Destinies change, eras change, the histories of nations change... but the person held by true love never changes.

dialogue: Kanton ko murjhane ka khauf nahi hota.
english_translation: Thorns do not fear withering away.

dialogue: Mogambo khush hua!
english_translation: Mogambo is pleased!

dialogue: Mogambo ki dushmani aur dosti dono buri hoti hain.
english_translation: Both Mogambo's friendship and enmity are deadly.

dialogue: Rishte mein toh hum tumhare baap lagte hain, naam hai Shahenshah.
english_translation: In terms of relations, I am your father, my name is Shahenshah.

dialogue: Hum jahan khade ho jaate hain, line wahin se shuru hoti hai.
english_translation: Where I stand, the queue starts from there.

dialogue: Vijay Dinanath Chauhan, poora naam. Baap ka naam Dinanath Chauhan, maa ka naam Suhasini Chauhan. Gaon Mandwa.
english_translation: Vijay Dinanath Chauhan, full name. Father's name Dinanath Chauhan, mother's name Suhasini Chauhan. Village Mandwa.

dialogue: Hawa tez chalti hai Dinkar Rao, toh topi ud jaati hai!
english_translation: When the wind blows fiercely Dinkar Rao, hats fly off!

dialogue: Tum kya leke aaye the, aur kya leke jaoge?
english_translation: What did you bring into this world, and what will you take with you?

dialogue: Insaan ko dibbe mein sirf tab hona chahiye jab woh mar chuka ho.
english_translation: A person should only be boxed inside a container when they are dead.

dialogue: Seize the day my friend, pehle is din ko poori tarah jiyo, phir 40 ke baare mein sochna.
english_translation: Seize the day my friend, live today completely first before worrying about turning forty.

dialogue: Dilon mein tum apni betabiyan leke chal rahe ho toh zinda ho tum.
english_translation: If you carry unrestrained passions in your heart, then you are alive.

dialogue: Mujhe afsos karna nahi aata.
english_translation: I don't know how to live in regret.

dialogue: Mhari chhoriyan chhoron se kam hain ke?
english_translation: Are my girls any less than boys?

dialogue: Medal ped pe nahi ugte, unhe banana padta hai... pyaar se, mehnat se, lagan se.
english_translation: Medals don't grow on trees, they have to be nurtured... with love, effort, and dedication.

dialogue: Silver jeeti toh aaj nahi toh kal log tanne bhool javenge... Gold jeeti toh misaal ban javegi.
english_translation: If you win silver, people will forget you sooner or later... if you win gold, you will become a legend.

dialogue: Kehte hain agar kisi cheez ko dil se chaho, toh poori kainath usse tumse milane ki koshish mein lag jaati hai.
english_translation: They say that if you truly desire something from the heart, the entire universe conspires to bring it to you.

dialogue: Hamari filmon ki tarah, hamari zindagi mein bhi end mein sab theek ho hi jaata hai... Happys Ending. Aur agar theek na ho, toh picture abhi baaki hai mere dost!
english_translation: Just like in our movies, in real life too everything turns out fine in the end... Happy Ending. And if it's not fine, then the movie isn't over yet my friend!

dialogue: Ek chutki sindoor ki keemat tum kya jaano Ramesh babu!
english_translation: What would you know of the value of a pinch of vermilion, Ramesh babu!

dialogue: Main udna chahta hoon, daudna chahta hoon, girna bhi chahta hoon... bas rukna nahi chahta.
english_translation: I want to fly, I want to run, I even want to fall... I just never want to stop.

dialogue: Kahin pahunchne ke liye, kahin se nikalna bahut zaroori hota hai.
english_translation: To reach somewhere, it is very important to leave from somewhere first.

dialogue: Tum pehle bhi itni khoobsurat thi ya waqt ne kiya koi haseen sitam?
english_translation: Were you always this beautiful, or has time performed a wondrous enchantment?

dialogue: Jitna bhi try karo Bunny, life mein kuch na kuch toh chhootega hi. Toh jahan hain, wahin ka maza lete hain na!
english_translation: No matter how hard you try Bunny, you'll always miss out on something in life. So let's just enjoy where we are right now!

dialogue: Kabhi kabhi jeetne ke liye kuch haarna bhi padta hai, aur haar kar jeetne wale ko Baazigar kehte hain.
english_translation: Sometimes to win, you have to lose something, and the one who wins after losing is called a Baazigar (gambler).

dialogue: I love you, K-K-K-Kiran!
english_translation: I love you, K-K-K-Kiran!

dialogue: Hum dost the, hain, aur hamesha rahenge.
english_translation: We were friends, we are friends, and we will remain friends forever.

dialogue: Ya toh dosti gehri hai, ya yeh photo 3D hai.
english_translation: Either the friendship is deep, or this photo is in 3D.

dialogue: Main nahi manta hamara desh duniya ka sabse mahan desh hai... lekin yeh zaroor manta hoon ki hum mein kabiliyat hai, taqat hai, isse mahan banane ki.
english_translation: I don't believe our country is the greatest in the world... but I strongly believe we have the capability and strength to make it great.

dialogue: Apne hi paani mein pighal jaana barf ka muqaddar hota hai.
english_translation: To melt in its own water is the destiny of ice.

dialogue: Sattar minute, sattar minute hai tumhare paas... shayad tumhari zindagi ke sabse khaas sattar minute.
english_translation: Seventy minutes, you have seventy minutes... perhaps the most precious seventy minutes of your entire life.

dialogue: Mujhe states ke naam na sunai dete hain na dikhai dete hain... sirf ek mulk ka naam sunai deta hai: INDIA!
english_translation: I neither hear nor see state names... I only hear one nation's name: INDIA!

dialogue: Sharat manjoor hai!
english_translation: The bet is accepted!

dialogue: Sach aur sahas hai jiske mann mein, ant mein jeet usi ki hogi.
english_translation: Whoever has truth and courage in their heart will ultimately triumph in the end.

dialogue: Teen guna lagaan dena padega!
english_translation: You will have to pay triple the land tax!

dialogue: Thappad se darr nahi lagta sahab, pyaar se lagta hai.
english_translation: I'm not afraid of slaps sir, I'm afraid of love.

dialogue: Hum yahan ke Robinhood hain... Robinhood Pandey!
english_translation: I am the Robinhood of this place... Robinhood Pandey!

dialogue: Hum tum mein itne chhed karenge ki confuse ho jaoge ki saans kahan se lein aur...
english_translation: I will put so many holes in you that you'll be confused where to breathe from and...

dialogue: Ek baar jo maine commitment kar di, uske baad toh main khud ki bhi nahi sunta.
english_translation: Once I make a commitment, after that I don't even listen to myself.

dialogue: Aata maajhi satakli!
english_translation: Now I have lost my temper!

dialogue: Jisme hai dum, toh fakht Bajirao Singham!
english_translation: If anyone has true courage, it is only Bajirao Singham!

dialogue: Tareekh pe tareekh, tareekh pe tareekh milti rahi hai janab, lekin insaaf nahi mila!
english_translation: Date after date, court date after court date we received my lord, but never justice!

dialogue: Yeh dhaai kilo ka haath jab kisi pe padta hai na, toh aadmi uthta nahi, uth jaata hai!
english_translation: When this two-and-a-half kilo hand strikes someone, they don't get up, they ascend to heaven!

dialogue: Yeh majdoor ka haath hai Katya, loha pighlakar uska aakaar badal deta hai!
english_translation: This is a laborer's hand Katya, it melts iron and alters its shape!

dialogue: Hamara Hindustan zindabad tha, zindabad hai, aur zindabad rahega!
english_translation: Our India was victorious, is victorious, and will remain victorious forever!

dialogue: Barsaat se bachne ki haisiyat nahi aur goli barsaane ki baat kar rahe hain aap log.
english_translation: You don't even have the shelter to escape the rain, and you talk about raining bullets.

dialogue: Har bachhe ki apni ek khoobi hoti hai, apni ek kabiliyat hoti hai, apni ek alag shakti hoti hai.
english_translation: Every child has their own special quality, their own talent, their own unique inner strength.

dialogue: Duniya mein aisi aisi hire paida huye hain, jinhone saari duniya ka naqsha hi badal diya.
english_translation: Diamonds have been born in this world who ended up changing the entire map of human understanding.

dialogue: Lul ho gayi hamri life!
english_translation: Our life turned completely upside down!

dialogue: Wrong number hai!
english_translation: That is a wrong number!

dialogue: Kaun bhagwan ko maane hum? Jo sabko banaya, ya jisko tum log banaye ho?
english_translation: Which God should I believe in? The One who created everyone, or the one that you people fabricated?

dialogue: Mera haal na Gupta uncle jaisa ho gaya hai... Gupta uncle ko na cancer ho gaya tha, unhone kabhi bidi nahi pee thi!
english_translation: My state is just like Gupta uncle... Gupta uncle got cancer even though he never smoked a single bidi!

dialogue: Indian ladkiyan burp nahi karti, seedha dakaar leti hain!
english_translation: Indian girls don't burp delicately, they let out full hearty belches!

dialogue: Motion se hi toh emotion juda hai.
english_translation: Emotion is intimately tied to bowel motion.

dialogue: Death aur shith... yeh do cheezein kisi ko, kahin bhi, kabhi bhi aa sakti hain.
english_translation: Death and shit... these two can visit anyone, anywhere, anytime.

dialogue: Gangu chaand thi aur chaand hi rahegi.
english_translation: Gangu was the moon, and the moon she shall remain.

dialogue: Izzat se jeene ka, kisi se darne ka nahi... na police se, na neta se, na mantri se, na kisi ke baap se!
english_translation: Live with dignity and fear nobody... not the police, not politicians, not ministers, nor anyone's father!

dialogue: O Stree kal aana!
english_translation: O Stree, come tomorrow!

dialogue: Woh stree hai, woh kuch bhi kar sakti hai!
english_translation: She is a woman, she is capable of anything!

dialogue: Nomoshkar! Ek minute...
english_translation: Greetings! Just one minute...

dialogue: Life mein sabse bada risk hota hai... kabhi koi risk na lena.
english_translation: The biggest risk in life is to never take any risk at all.

dialogue: Life is an ice cream, enjoy it before it melts.
english_translation: Life is an ice cream, enjoy it before it melts.

dialogue: Hum hain ki hum nahi?
english_translation: To be or not to be?

dialogue: Inteqaam se sirf inteqaam paida hota hai.
english_translation: Revenge only breeds more revenge.

dialogue: Insaaf andha hota hai par aakhein sabki khuli rehti hain.
english_translation: Justice is blind, but everyone's eyes remain wide open.

dialogue: Kabhi kabhi galat train bhi sahi jagah pahuncha deti hai.
english_translation: Sometimes the wrong train can lead you to the right station.

dialogue: Bihad mein toh baaghi hote hain, dacoit milte hain parliament mein.
english_translation: In the ravines dwell rebels; the real dacoits are found in Parliament.

dialogue: Angrezi Bharat mein zuban nahi hai, class hai.
english_translation: English in India isn't just a language, it's a social class.

dialogue: Mummy papa sex karte hain toh sharminda kyun hote hain sab?
english_translation: If parents have sex, why is everyone so embarrassed about it?

dialogue: What is life? It depends on the liver.
english_translation: What is life? It depends on the liver.

dialogue: In sabki aukaat humein yaad dilani padti hai sir... Article 15 kehta hai sab barabar hain.
english_translation: We must remind them of their status sir... Article 15 declares everyone is equal.

dialogue: Yeh duniya kisi ki laalach ke liye nahi, zaroorat ke liye bani hai.
english_translation: This world was created to satisfy human need, not human greed.

dialogue: Soja varna Hastar aa jayega!
english_translation: Go to sleep or Hastar will come for you!

dialogue: How's the josh? High, Sir!
english_translation: How's the spirit? High, Sir!

dialogue: Yeh naya Hindustan hai, yeh ghar mein ghusega bhi aur marega bhi!
english_translation: This is a new India, it will enter your home and strike you down!

dialogue: Freedom is the birthright of every human being.
english_translation: Freedom is the birthright of every human being.

dialogue: Restart! Agar ek baar nahi hua, toh dobara restart karenge!
english_translation: Restart! If it didn't happen the first time, we will restart all over again!

dialogue: Haar tab hoti hai jab aap ladna chhod dete hain.
english_translation: Defeat only happens when you stop fighting.

dialogue: Yeh dil maange more!
english_translation: This heart yearns for more!

dialogue: Tiranga lehra kar aaoonga, nahi toh usme lipat kar aaoonga, lekin aaoonga zaroor.
english_translation: I will either return waving the tricolor, or wrapped inside it, but I will return for sure.

dialogue: Violence, violence, violence... I don't like it. I avoid! But violence likes me, I can't avoid!
english_translation: Violence, violence, violence... I don't like it. I avoid! But violence likes me, I can't avoid!

dialogue: Ghayal sher ki saansein uski dahaad se zyada khatarnak hoti hain.
english_translation: A wounded lion's breath is far more dangerous than its roar.

dialogue: Yudh se pehle shanti zaroori hoti hai.
english_translation: Before war, calm is necessary.

dialogue: Mera vachan hi hai mera shasan!
english_translation: My word itself is my law!

dialogue: Kattappa ne Baahubali ko kyun maara?
english_translation: Why did Kattappa kill Baahubali?

dialogue: Devasena ko kisi ne haath lagaya toh samjho Baahubali ki talwar ko dhaar di!
english_translation: If anyone lays a finger on Devasena, consider it sharpening Baahubali's blade!

dialogue: Pushpa... Pushparaj... Main jhukega nahi sala!
english_translation: Pushpa... Pushparaj... I will never bow down!

dialogue: Pushpa naam sunke flower samjhe kya? Fire hai main!
english_translation: Hearing the name Pushpa, did you think I was a flower? I am fire!

dialogue: Bete ko haath lagane se pehle, baap se baat kar!
english_translation: Before you lay a hand on the son, talk to the father!

dialogue: Main kaun hoon? Punya hoon ya paap hoon... bas jo hoon, aap hoon.
english_translation: Who am I? Virtue or sin... whatever I am, I am you.

dialogue: Party agar Pathaan ke ghar rakhoge, toh mehmaannawazi ke liye Pathaan toh aayega hi!
english_translation: If you throw a party at Pathaan's house, then Pathaan will surely arrive to host you!

dialogue: Apni kursi ki peti baandh lo, mausam bigadne wala hai!
english_translation: Fasten your seatbelts, the weather is about to turn rough!

dialogue: Papa ke liye main duniya jala sakta hoon.
english_translation: For my father, I can burn the entire world down.

dialogue: Kaun hai yeh jisne doobara mudke mujhe nahi dekha? Who is he?
english_translation: Who is this person who didn't turn back to look at me again? Who is he?

dialogue: Keh diya na, bas keh diya!
english_translation: I said it, and that is final!

dialogue: Zindagi mein kuch banna ho, kuch haasil karna ho, toh hamesha apne dil ki suno.
english_translation: If you want to achieve something in life, always listen to your heart.

dialogue: Kuch kuch hota hai Rahul, tum nahi samjhoge.
english_translation: Something happens inside Rahul, you wouldn't understand.

dialogue: Pyaar dosti hai... agar woh meri sabse achhi dost nahi ban sakti, toh main usse kabhi pyaar kar hi nahi sakta.
english_translation: Love is friendship... if she cannot be my best friend, I can never truly love her.

dialogue: Hum ek baar jeete hain, ek baar marte hain, shaadi bhi ek baar hoti hai... aur pyaar, pyaar bhi ek hi baar hota hai.
english_translation: We live once, we die once, marriage happens once... and love, love also happens only once.

dialogue: Hanso, muskurao, kya pata kal ho naa ho!
english_translation: Laugh, smile, who knows if tomorrow will ever come!

dialogue: Aaj ek hasi aur baant lo, aaj ek dua aur maang lo... kya pata kal ho naa ho.
english_translation: Share one more smile today, say one more prayer today... who knows if tomorrow will come.

dialogue: Pyaar toh bahut log karte hain, lekin mere jaisa pyaar koi nahi kar sakta kyunki kisi ke paas tum jo nahi ho.
english_translation: Many people love, but no one can love like me because no one else has you.

dialogue: Parampara, Pratishtha, Anushasan... yeh is Gurukul ke teen stambh hain.
english_translation: Tradition, Prestige, Discipline... these are the three pillars of this Gurukul.

dialogue: Duniya mein kitni hai nafratein, phir bhi dilon mein hai mohabbatein.
english_translation: However much hatred exists in the world, love still resides within our hearts.

dialogue: Mohabbat bhi zindagi ki tarah hoti hai, har mod aasan nahi hota.
english_translation: Love is just like life, not every turn is easy.

dialogue: Babuji ne kaha gaon chhod do, sab ne kaha Paro ko chhod do, Paro ne kaha sharab chhod do... aaj tumne keh diya haweli chhod do, ek din aayega jab woh kahenge duniya hi chhod do.
english_translation: Father said leave the village, everyone said leave Paro, Paro said leave alcohol... today you said leave the mansion, one day will come when they say leave the world entirely.

dialogue: Kaun kambakht bardaasht karne ko peeta hai? Main toh peeta hoon ki bas saans le sakoon.
english_translation: What wretched person drinks merely to endure? I drink only so that I can breathe.

dialogue: Yeh police station hai, tumhare baap ka ghar nahi. Isliye seedhe khade raho!
english_translation: This is a police station, not your father's home. So stand straight!

dialogue: Sher khan ka dost banna chahta hai ya dushman?
english_translation: Do you want to become Sher Khan's friend or enemy?

dialogue: Aisa toh aadmi doich time bhagta hai... Olympic ka race ho ya police ka case ho!
english_translation: A man runs like this only two times... either it's an Olympic race or a police case!

dialogue: Zindagi toh bewafa hai ek din thukrayegi... maut mehbooba hai apne saath lekar jayegi.
english_translation: Life is unfaithful and will forsake you one day... death is the true lover who will take you along.

dialogue: I can talk English, I can walk English, I can laugh English because English is a very phunny language!
english_translation: I can talk English, I can walk English, I can laugh English because English is a very funny language!

dialogue: Yeh kahan aa gaye hum, yunhi saath saath chalte.
english_translation: Where have we arrived, just walking along side by side.

dialogue: Kabhi kabhie mere dil mein khayal aata hai... ki jaise tujhko banaya gaya hai mere liye.
english_translation: Sometimes a thought crosses my heart... as if you were created just for me.

dialogue: Aapke paon dekhe, bahut haseen hain... inhe zameen par mat utariyega, maile ho jayenge.
english_translation: I saw your feet, they are exquisite... please do not place them on the ground, they will get soiled.

dialogue: Jinke apne ghar sheeshe ke hote hain, woh doosron ke gharon par patthar nahi phenka karte.
english_translation: Those who live in glass houses shouldn't throw stones at others.

dialogue: Yeh bachhon ke khelne ki cheez nahi, haath kat jaye toh khoon nikal aata hai!
english_translation: This is not a toy for children, if your hand gets cut, blood will flow!

dialogue: Hum tumhe marenge, aur zaroor marenge... lekin bandook bhi hamari hogi, goli bhi hamari hogi aur waqt bhi hamara hoga!
english_translation: I will kill you, and kill you for sure... but the gun will be mine, the bullet will be mine, and the time will be mine!

dialogue: Na talwar ki dhar se, na goliyon ki bauchar se... banda darta hai toh sirf parvardigar se!
english_translation: Neither by blade's edge nor bullet shower... this man fears none but the Almighty Creator!

dialogue: Apna usool kehta hai... har galti ki sazaa maut hai!
english_translation: My principle dictates... the penalty for every betrayal is death!

dialogue: Zindagi maut se shuru hoti hai aur maut par khatam hoti hai.
english_translation: Life begins from struggle and concludes in death.

dialogue: Main ek aurat hoon, par pehle ek maa hoon.
english_translation: I am a woman, but first and foremost I am a mother.

dialogue: Na koi marta hai, na koi maarta hai... aatma ajar amar hai.
english_translation: Nobody dies, nobody kills... the soul is immortal and imperishable.

dialogue: Yeh mehlon, yeh takhton, yeh taajon ki duniya... agar mil bhi jaye toh kya hai?
english_translation: This world of palaces, thrones, and crowns... even if one wins it all, what is it worth?

dialogue: Waqt ne kiya kya haseen sitam... tum rahe na tum, hum rahe na hum.
english_translation: What sweet tyranny time has wrought... you are no longer you, and I am no longer I.

dialogue: Moochh nahi toh kuch nahi! A man without a moustache is like a cup without a handle.
english_translation: No moustache means no manliness! A man without a moustache is like a cup without a handle.

dialogue: Kurta phaad ke gussa dikhana hamari aadat nahi!
english_translation: Tearing my shirt to express anger is not my style!

dialogue: Shuddh Hindi bolne mein jo anand hai, woh kisi aur bhasha mein nahi.
english_translation: The delight in speaking pure Hindi is unparalleled in any other tongue.

dialogue: Draupadi teri akele ki nahi hai... hum sab share holder hain!
english_translation: Draupadi is not yours alone... we are all shareholders here!

dialogue: Shaant gadadhari Bheem, shaant!
english_translation: Calm down mace-wielding Bheem, calm down!

dialogue: Mumbai ka king kaun? Bhiku Mhatre!
english_translation: Who is the king of Mumbai? Bhiku Mhatre!

dialogue: Goli maar bheje mein, bheja shor karta hai!
english_translation: Shoot a bullet in the brain, the brain makes too much noise!

dialogue: Ganda hai par dhanda hai yeh!
english_translation: It may be dirty, but it's business!

dialogue: Mujhe jo sahi lagta hai main karta hoon, chahe woh bhagwan ke khilaaf ho, kanoon ke khilaaf ho ya poore system ke khilaaf!
english_translation: I do whatever feels right to me, whether it goes against God, against the law, or against the entire system!

dialogue: Nazdeeki fayda dekhne se pehle, door ka nuksaan sochna chahiye.
english_translation: Before looking at short-term gain, one should calculate the long-term loss.

dialogue: Kanoon andha hota hai par judge toh dekh sakta hai!
english_translation: The law is blind, but the judge can surely see!

dialogue: Zindagi jeene ke do hi tareeqe hote hain... ek jo ho raha hai hone do, bardaasht karte jao... ya phir zimmedari uthao usse badalne ki.
english_translation: There are only two ways to live life... either endure whatever is happening, or take responsibility to change it.

dialogue: Koi bhi desh perfect nahi hota, usse behtar banana padta hai.
english_translation: No country is perfect, it has to be made better.

dialogue: College ki boundary ke bahar ek duniya hai, jahan sab kuch alag hai.
english_translation: Outside the boundary of college lies a world where everything is different.

dialogue: Jab log tumhare khilaaf bolne lagein, samajh lo tarakki kar rahe ho.
english_translation: When people start speaking against you, understand that you are progressing in life.

dialogue: Agar sapne dekhna chhod diya, toh jeena chhod diya.
english_translation: If you stop dreaming, you stop living.

dialogue: Main apni favorite hoon!
english_translation: I am my own favorite!

dialogue: Sikhni hoon main Bhatinda ki!
english_translation: I am a fierce Sikh girl from Bhatinda!

dialogue: Akeli ladki khuli hui tijori ki tarah hoti hai.
english_translation: A girl traveling alone is considered like an open treasury.
